title: Original M6 fixed-span asymptotic improvement and nontrivial unbounded domain
scope: Original section6 fixedR comparison, not arbitrary-span efficiency.

spec.name: M6.FixedSpan.distance_improvement
spec.statement: ∀ R : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ)^3 * (4 : ℝ)^R / (4 : ℝ)^N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
spec.guidance: Use tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt 3 (r:=4), multiply limit by constant4^R and ring rearrange. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.FixedSpan.witness_improvement
spec.statement: ∀ R : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ)^4 * (4 : ℝ)^R / (4 : ℝ)^N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
spec.guidance: Same standard polynomial/geometric limit with exponent4. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.FixedSpan.recipe_support
spec.guidance: Ext coefficient index, expand1+X+X²; binary coefficients at distinct0,1,2 are1. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.FixedSpan.recipe_degree
spec.guidance: Use leading term X², degree computations; polynomial commutativity to monic_X_pow_add lower-degree expression. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.FixedSpan.recipe_divides
spec.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, 3 ∣ N → M6.FixedSpan.recipe ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N
spec.guidance: First (1+X+X²)*(X+1)=X³+1 in characteristic2, then 3|N and a-1 divides a^k-1 witha=X³. Retain all repeated factors in ambientmodulus. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.FixedSpan.recipe_signature
spec.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, 3 ∣ N → M6.Cyclic.signature M6.FixedSpan.recipe M6.FixedSpan.recipe (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) = M6.FixedSpan.recipe
spec.guidance: Unfold signature; gcd_self and gcd_eq_left from recipe_divides. Use EuclideanDomain gcd APIs. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.FixedSpan.nontrivial_family
spec.statement: ∀ k : ℕ, let N := 3*(k+1); 2 < N ∧ M6.FixedSpan.recipe.support.card = 3 ∧ 0 ∈ M6.FixedSpan.recipe.support ∧ Nat.gcd N (M6.FixedSpan.recipe.support.gcd id) = 1 ∧ (M6.Cyclic.signature M6.FixedSpan.recipe M6.FixedSpan.recipe (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)).natDegree = 2
spec.guidance: Apply recipe_signature with3|N, degree/support lemmas; support contains1 and finite gcd=1; omega givesN>2. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
